今天天气真好 <button onclick="(function(){const c=document.createElement('div');c.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:999999;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(c);for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const s=28+Math.random()*42,e=document.createElement('div');e.textContent='💩';e.style.cssText='position:absolute;font-size:'+s+'px;left:'+(Math.random()*90+5)+'%;top:-60px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,200,50,0.6))';c.appendChild(e);const p={el:e,x:parseFloat(e.style.left),y:-60,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*3,vy:Math.random()*2+1,w:s*0.75,h:s*0.75};!function f(){const W=c.clientWidth,H=c.clientHeight;p.vy+=0.4;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0){p.x=0;p.vx=-p.vx*0.8}if(p.x+p.w>W){p.x=W-p.w;p.vx=-p.vx*0.8}if(p.y+p.h>H){p.y=H-p.h;p.vy=-p.vy*0.65;p.vx*=0.995}if(p.y<-300){p.y=-60;p.x=Math.random()*90+5;p.vy=Math.random()*2+1;p.vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*2}p.el.style.left=p.x+'px';p.el.style.top=p.y+'px';requestAnimationFrame(f)}()}})()" style="padding:8px 16px;background:#ffeb3b;border-radius:20px;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;font-weight:bold;">💩 点我</button>
